:::{#def-prediction-error}
#### Prediction error

A [prediction function](#def-prediction) $\predfnf{\Predvar}$ has as its estimand
the observed outcome $\Outvar$ of a new data point with input $\Predvar$,
not the conditional mean of that outcome.
The **prediction error** of $\predfn$ is the prediction minus that outcome:

$$\prederr_{\predfn} \eqdef \predfnf{\Predvar} - \Outvar$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-prediction-error}
#### Prediction error in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
the constant prediction $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$ has prediction error $\prederr_{\predfn_1} = 3 - \Outvar$,
which is $3$ when $\Outvar = 0$ and $-3$ when $\Outvar = 6$.

:::
